title: Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs) for Post-Deployment Physical AI
abstract: arXiv:2609.04552v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unattended interactive autonomy - machines that step into danger in place of humans and complete tasks with human tools - remains a missing capability in mission-critical operations. These domains offer scarce training data and only onboard compute, yet deployed systems must face novelty without erasing prior competence.   We introduce Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs), which learn efficiently in the lab and continue learning after deployment through autonomous, gradient-free, on-device updates. CFAM uses a complementary learning architecture with a frozen slow-learning component and a fast-learning Capsule Field. The slow component contains three cortices: Sensor, which maps multimodal input into 3D-grounded geometry; Reasoning, which decomposes tasks into skills and evaluates outcomes; and Action, which executes geometric skills. translated_title: 用于部署后物理人工智能的持续场自适应模型（CFAMs）
translated_abstract: 无人值守的交互式自主能力——即机器能够替代人类进入危险环境并使用人类工具完成任务——仍然是任务关键型行动中缺失的一项能力。这些领域训练数据稀缺，且仅有机载计算资源，然而部署后的系统必须在不遗忘既有能力的前提下应对新颖情况。我们提出了持续场自适应模型（CFAMs），它能够在实验室中高效学习，并在部署后通过自主的、无梯度的、设备端更新实现持续学习。CFAM采用一种互补学习架构，由一个冻结的慢速学习组件和一个快速学习的胶囊场组成。慢速组件包含三个皮层：感知皮层，将多模态输入映射为具有三维基础属性的几何表征；推理皮层，将任务分解为技能并评估执行结果；动作皮层，负责执行几何技能。胶囊场以能力胶囊的形式一次性、无梯度地存储场域学习内容。
tldr: 该论文提出持续场自适应模型（CFAMs），一种通过互补学习架构在部署后仍能以无梯度、设备端自主更新方式持续学习新能力且不遗忘既有技能的物理人工智能系统，适用于训练数据稀缺的任务关键型场景。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs), a physical AI architecture with a complementary learning design that continues learning after deployment through autonomous, gradient-free, on-device updates, enabling adaptation to novelty without forgetting prior competence in data-scarce, mission-critical settings.
